scenario_description:
Objective: Keep the Vascular Access Ultrasound Skills Lab able to count its planned hands-on equipment station in the accredited packet.
Emerging Need: Once the ultrasound station is confirmed, the required device-cleaning attestation is still absent before supplement export.
Decision Context: Early scheduling leaves the station conditional; later scope, folder, and cutoff records make the missing prerequisite actionable while the authorized attestation source is only in activity records.
Consequence: If the attestation path is not opened before export, the session can proceed but the hands-on station loses creditable status.

parameter.title: Vascular Access Ultrasound Skills Lab
parameter.description: Accredited skills lab session; hands-on ultrasound station line remains tentative pending faculty scope confirmation. Standard slide review proceeds either way.

parameter.subject: Scope confirmation for vascular access lab
parameter.body: We are keeping the portable ultrasound-guided access station in the accredited skills lab. Please treat it as a learner hands-on component, not merely a slide demonstration.

parameter.content: I updated the draft agenda line for CE-VASC with the ultrasound hands-on station. In the accreditation folder, the device-cleaning attestation field is still empty; all speaker disclosures for this session are marked received.

parameter.title: CE-VASC supplement upload cutoff
parameter.content: Final supplement upload for CE-VASC closes at 15:30; after that only already-attached compliance items are exported into the accreditation packet.

parameter.subject: CE-VASC supplement export closed
parameter.body: The 15:30 supplement export is complete. The device-cleaning attestation field remained blank, so the ultrasound hands-on station is listed as non-creditable equipment practice in the exported packet. The skills lab calendar entry remains unchanged.
